login.title: Sign in to Relay
login.subtitle: Use the Google account of your organization.
login.failed: Could not sign in. Please try again.

create.title: Create an organization
create.subtitle: API keys belong to an organization. Name yours to get started; members can be invited afterwards.
create.name: Organization name
create.error: The organization could not be created. Please try again.

members.title: Members
members.subtitle: Owners and admins manage keys, members and invitations; members use the console and read the keys.

list.title: Members
list.description: Everyone with access to this organization in Relay.

updateRole.error: The role could not be updated.

remove.title: Remove this member?
remove.message: {name} loses access to this organization immediately.
remove.error: The member could not be removed.

leave.title: Leave this organization?
leave.message: You lose access to {name}. Another owner or admin can invite you again.
leave.error: You could not leave the organization.

errors.lastOwner: The organization needs at least one owner. Make another member an owner first.
errors.alreadyMember: This person is already a member of the organization.
errors.alreadyInvited: This email already has a pending invitation.
errors.notAllowed: Your role does not allow this.

list.title: Pending invitations
list.description: Relay sends no email: share the link with the person you invited.

create.title: Invite a member
create.description: You will get a link to share; the invitee signs in with the Google account of this email.
create.error: The invitation could not be created.

created.title: Invitation created
created.description: Send this link to {email}. It can be copied again from the pending invitations.

revoke.title: Revoke this invitation?
revoke.message: The link sent to {email} stops working.
revoke.error: The invitation could not be revoked.

invitation.title: Join the organization
invitation.description: {inviter} invited you to join. Your role will be {role}.
invitation.error: The invitation could not be answered. Please try again.

invalid.title: This invitation is no longer valid
invalid.description: It may have expired, been accepted already, or been revoked. Ask an owner or admin of the organization for a new link.

notRecipient.title: This invitation is for another account
notRecipient.description: You are signed in as {email}. Sign in with the Google account the invitation was sent to.

overview.subtitle: Requests to the Relay API carry one of this organization's keys.

quickStart.title: Quick start
quickStart.description: Create a key, then send it as the bearer token.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.subtitle: Keys belong to this organization. The secret is shown once, when the key is created.

list.title: Keys
list.description: Revoking a key rejects its requests immediately.
list.error: The keys could not be loaded.

create.title: Create API key
create.description: Name the key after the service that will use it.
create.name: Name
create.error: The key could not be created.

created.title: Key created
created.description: Send it as the bearer token of every request.
created.onceDescription: The secret is not shown again. A lost key has to be revoked and replaced.

revoke.title: Revoke this key?
revoke.error: The key could not be revoked.
